[serious tone] This decisive engagement marked the concluding chapter of the Mongol invasion of the Khwarazmian Empire. [dramatic tone] Jalal al-Din's army found itself trapped against the mighty Indus River.

[desperate] With his forces outnumbered and cornered on the riverbanks, the Shah realized his position was [sorrowful] hopeless.

[sorrowful] Though Jalal al-Din escaped, his family and nearly all his remaining soldiers were tragically lost, signifying the end of organized Khwarazmian resistance.
